sources.excerpt: BUZZAROUND - Bad Pixel Pedals Fuzz Overdrive Boost CLASSIC SERIES Custom Videos artwork About BAD PIXEL PEDALS BUZZAROUND FUZZ -------------------------------------------------------------------------------- * handmade in Greeece * point to point construction * NOS USSR MILITARY SPEC CAPACITORS * CARBON COMP RESISTORS * 3X NOS USSR GERMANIUM TRANSISTORS [MP20/26] * NOS USSR GERMANIUM D9E DIODE [THE KLON CENTAUR MAGICAL DIODE] * Alpha pots * Neutrik jacks * Hammond aluminum enclosure [polished to a shiny look] * Chemically etched graphics * true buypass -------------------------------------------------------------------------------- This fuzz has the best of both worlds. It cleans very well [almost like a fuzz face] but then when you open the volume pot it will kick you a tone of Tone Bender sustain. All the control is in your hands [you don't have to turn on and off the effect]. The controls on this one can achieve some very serious tones. This thing is a monster. No wonder it is so much sought after. Very few of them in the market nowadays. Construction - wise, it is built like a tank with respect to the original circuit construction. Those old Russian transistors sound amazing!!!!! You take it to the studio and thank me later!!!!! This is a classic effect that can be now yours. Take the chance. Powered with a 9v battery or a standard negative tip adapter. It is positive ground so do not daisy chain with other negative ground pedals.
